        rw [Finset.mem_toList, Finsupp.mem_graph_iff] at hb hc
        dsimp at hb hc
        rw [← hc.1, hb.1]
      · apply Finset.nodup_toList⟩

theorem toAList_keys_toFinset [DecidableEq α] (f : α →₀ M) :
